items.title: Matching affine simplicial meshes and shape regularity
items.strategy: Fix a face-to-face finite simplicial mesh, reference affine maps, and the uniform inradius-to-diameter convention.

items.title: Oriented simplicial cell chains and boundary
items.strategy: Define oriented simplex generators and the alternating simplicial boundary operator.

items.title: The simplicial boundary of a boundary is zero
items.strategy: Pair the two deletion orders for each codimension-two face and show their signs cancel.

items.title: Broken and conforming polynomial spaces on a matching mesh
items.strategy: Define broken cellwise polynomial functions, face-matching conformity, and the zero-boundary subspace by exact trace conditions.

items.title: Reference finite elements and unisolvent degrees of freedom
items.strategy: State the finite-dimensional function space, number of linear functionals, and injective degree-of-freedom map convention.

items.title: Unisolvent degrees of freedom define a unique reference interpolant
items.strategy: Use the bijective degree-of-freedom map and its dual basis to define and verify the interpolation projector.

items.title: Polynomial derivative and face norms are controlled on a reference simplex
items.strategy: Use compactness of the coefficient unit sphere and positivity of the interior Lp norm to control derivative and face norms.

items.title: Affine pullback of weak derivatives and Sobolev seminorms
items.strategy: Transform the weak test identity and iterate the constant-matrix chain rule; record determinant and matrix-norm factors.

items.title: Shape regularity controls affine simplex geometry
items.strategy: Bound the Jacobian and inverse by cell diameter and inradius, then derive volume and face-measure scaling.

items.title: Interior facet orientations cancel in a matching mesh
items.strategy: Use the two opposite outward normals on each interior facet and retain each boundary facet once.

items.title: Gauss–Green formula on an affine simplex
items.strategy: Prove the reference-simplex formula by coordinatewise FTC and Fubini, then transform normals by the cofactor map.

items.title: Smooth functions are dense in finite-order Sobolev spaces on a reference simplex
items.strategy: Contract the simplex toward its barycenter, use strong continuity of affine pullbacks, then mollify on a neighborhood of the closure.

items.title: A reference simplex is an integer-order Sobolev extension domain
items.strategy: Cover the finite face strata by affine orthant charts, extend by successive half-space reflections, localize, and sum a finite partition.

items.title: Sobolev face traces and Gauss–Green on a reference simplex
items.strategy: Establish the face trace bound for smooth functions by a cell vector field, extend from the dense class, and pass the smooth Green identity to conjugate exponents.

items.title: Continuous matching piecewise polynomials belong to W1p
items.strategy: Integrate by parts cellwise against a test function; matching face values cancel every interior distributional jump.

items.title: Zero-boundary conforming polynomials lie in W0 1p and satisfy Poincare
items.strategy: Use zero boundary face values to remove boundary jumps, cut off in a shrinking boundary layer, approximate compactly supported pieces, then apply the exact W10p Poincare theorem.

items.title: Poincare–Wirtinger inequality on a reference simplex
items.strategy: Average the segment FTC inequality over all pairs, split the segment parameter at one half, and use convexity for the two changes of variables.

items.title: Bramble–Hilbert approximation on a reference simplex
items.strategy: Choose a unique polynomial matching all derivative means through order r−1, then apply Poincare recursively to its mean-zero derivative errors.

items.title: Local interpolation estimates on shape-regular affine meshes
items.strategy: Bound the reference error operator, use polynomial reproduction and Bramble–Hilbert, then transform each Sobolev seminorm to and from the reference cell.

items.title: Polynomial inverse and discrete trace inequalities
items.strategy: Apply finite-dimensional norm equivalence on the reference cell and facet and track the volume, face, and derivative scaling powers.

items.title: Covariant and contravariant Piola maps and H(div)/H(curl) spaces
items.strategy: Define H(div), H(curl), signed orientation, and both affine Piola pushforwards with their domains and codomains.

items.title: Affine Piola maps commute with differential operators and preserve moments
items.strategy: Use the affine chain rule, determinant/cofactor identities, and simplex Green pairings to prove H(div) and H(curl) map and moment formulas.

items.title: Affine Piola transport preserves commuting interpolation diagrams
items.strategy: Conjugate the reference interpolation operators by the exact Piola pullbacks and use the proved differential transformation identities.

items.title: Sobolev threshold for Lagrange point evaluations on a reference simplex
items.strategy: Apply the exact higher-order embedding to the proved simplex extension domain; handle W1,infinity separately by the Lipschitz representative.

items.title: Affine maps for a triangle and a parallelogram
items.strategy: Compute explicit affine matrices, determinants, image vertices, and areas for one triangle and one parallelogram.

items.title: A shape-regular family and a degenerating sliver family
items.strategy: Compare similar equilateral refinements with triangles whose altitude tends to zero while diameter stays bounded below.

items.title: Point evaluation is unbounded at the two-dimensional H1 threshold
items.strategy: Construct smooth logarithmic cutoffs with fixed center value and H1 norm tending to zero in an interior disk.

items.title: Opposite orientations cancel on a two-triangle mesh
items.strategy: Write both oriented triangle boundaries and verify the shared edge occurs once with each sign.
